style.name: traced-line + coded hatch
style.description: Ben's hand-drawn linework traced to smooth vector fills, keeping the marker's stroke-weight variation. Shading is redrawn in code as hand-style hatching (per-stroke angle jitter, wobble, ragged ends) at laser-safe spacing. Large solids get gap channels unless they are display lettering. Rules: line >= 0.25 mm, gap >= 0.30 mm, no islands < 0.09 mm2, 0.5 mm clear of every cut.
